subject: pi
title: Cache warming gated on expected dollar savings, not TTL alone
one_why: Warming refreshes are sent only when expected savings exceed $0.05 with an idle-continuation probability (0.15) measured from their own usage - turns cache warming from a blanket cost into a computed bet; nuance over the existing prompt-cache-warming concept.

subject: pi
title: 6852-LOC interactive-mode UI host in an otherwise exemplar modular tree
one_why: Largest file in the anchor set (2x codex's tolerated turn.rs); it is presentation-layer so the core loop stays clean, but it is the single dimension swing between pi's A band (architecture 9) and B (8).

subject: pi
title: Real eval harness exists but no workflow runs it
one_why: packages/evals wires vitest-evals + autoevals including documentation-audit evals, yet grep of .github/workflows finds no eval job; wiring it into CI is the cheapest step that separates pi's verification 8 from the 10 rung.

subject: pi
title: Blocking hook enforced and tested, but zero built-in approval default
one_why: Loop honors beforeToolCall block/terminate and tests it (agent-loop.test.ts:1735), yet shipping pi asks nothing by default - policy lives in examples/extensions/permission-gate.ts; honest (SECURITY.md:50) but caps safety-enforcement at 6.
